product_overview: Vasavi Traders is a construction materials storefront web app that lets customers browse products, compare options, reserve pickup orders, and get help from a Nova AI assistant. It also provides customer login, account access, and an admin portal for reservation oversight.
core_goals: Browse construction materials by category and search for specific products
Compare two products side by side before choosing a material
Reserve in-stock materials for store pickup
Chat with Nova AI for material estimation and crack-related guidance
Register and sign in as a customer using email or phone credentials
Access an admin dashboard to review reservation activity and stock metrics

features.name: Landing Page and Navigation
features.description: The homepage introduces the business, highlights key statistics, and provides navigation to the main app areas.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View the hero showcase and business statistics -> Review trusted brand indicators -> Open the products page from the navigation
Navigate to / -> Review the homepage content -> Open the contact page from the navigation
Navigate to / -> Review the homepage content -> Open the Nova assistant from the navigation
Navigate to / -> Review the homepage content -> Open the login page from the navigation

features.name: Product Filtering and Comparison
features.description: Customers can search the catalog, filter products by category, and compare two materials side by side.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> View the product catalog -> Type a search query -> Review the filtered results
Navigate to /products -> View the product catalog -> Select a category tab -> Review the products for that category
Navigate to /products -> View the product catalog -> Mark two products for comparison -> View the comparison drawer with side-by-side specifications
Navigate to /products -> View the product catalog -> Clear the search or switch categories -> Review the updated product list

features.name: Material Pickup Reservation
features.description: Customers can reserve available materials for store pickup by submitting a reservation form from a product card.
user_flows: Navigate to /products -> View the product catalog -> Open a reservation from a product card -> Fill in name, phone, quantity, pickup date, and notes -> Submit the reservation form -> See a success confirmation
Navigate to /products -> View the product catalog -> Open a reservation from a product card -> Enter reservation details -> Submit the reservation form -> See the reservation completion message

features.name: Nova AI Assistant Chat
features.description: Customers can ask Nova questions about materials, use Telugu voice input, upload crack images, and hear spoken responses.
user_flows: Navigate to /nova -> Type a construction or estimation question -> Send the message -> Review Nova's response -> Hear audio playback
Navigate to /nova -> Activate voice dictation -> Speak a question in Telugu -> Review the transcribed message -> Send the message -> Review Nova's response
Navigate to /nova -> Upload a structural crack image -> Review Nova's analysis and suggestion -> Hear audio playback
Navigate to /nova -> Ask a materials question -> Review the suggested guidance -> Continue the chat with another message

features.name: Customer Registration
features.description: New customers can create an account using their name, email, phone number, and a 6-digit passcode.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Select the registration mode -> Enter name, email, phone number, and 6-digit passcode -> Submit the registration form -> See the registration success message

features.name: Email Authentication and Session
features.description: Customers can sign in with email and a 6-digit passcode to reach their account area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Select the email sign-in mode -> Enter email and 6-digit passcode -> Submit the login form -> Reach the customer dashboard or home screen

features.name: Phone Authentication and Session
features.description: Customers can sign in with phone number and a 6-digit passcode to reach their account area.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Select the phone sign-in mode -> Enter phone number and 6-digit passcode -> Submit the login form -> Reach the customer dashboard

features.name: Admin Portal and Controls
features.description: Authorized admin users can sign in and review reservation analytics, pickup lists, and catalog stock metrics.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Open admin access -> Enter the admin credentials -> Submit the access form -> Reach the admin dashboard
Navigate to /login -> Open admin access -> Enter the admin credentials -> Submit the access form -> Review reservation stats and recent pickup records

routes.description: Landing page featuring a 3D hero showcase, trust badges, and business key statistics.
Product catalog with category filter tabs, comparison mode, product search, and reservations.
Contact page with maps, contact form, physical address, business hours, and phone info.
Multi-mode authentication portal supporting email/password, phone/password, registration, and admin access.
Nova AI assistant chat module with material estimations, Telugu voice TTS, and automated crack detection.
User dashboard listing past and current material pickup reservations.
Customer profile dashboard showing general account information and quick navigation links.
Control room showing reservation analytics, customer pickup lists, and catalog stock metrics.
